newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian journalist said murdered after reports.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian journalist said murdered after reports.

text.p: An Indonesian journalist is believed to have been beaten to death days after publishing reports on corruption of local officials, the Jakarta Post newspaper said on Saturday.
Muhammad Sayuti Haji Bochari was found unconscious on Monday afternoon in a street of Luwu, 400 km (250 miles) north of Ujung Pandang on the island of Sulawesi, the newspaper said.
Sayuti, from the Ujung Pandang-based Pos Makassar weekly, died in Palopo hospital on Wednesday from head and neck injuries.

Pos Makassar chief editor Andi Tonra Mahie was quoted as saying Sayuti had been killed and that his death was linked to his reports on the embezzlement of funds allocated for poverty alleviation in Luwu.
The Jakarta Post quoted local police as saying he died in a traffic accident. It also said relatives had insisted he had been murdered.
Last August, journalist Fuad Muhammad Syafuddin working for the Bernas daily in the central Java city of Yogyakarta was killed after writing about corruption in a local administration.
